artworks.title: Title Page for "Il Solimano"
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20 x 14 cm (7 7/8 x 5 1/2 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth B. Benedict in memory of William S. Benedict
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornately dressed figure standing between two columns with shields and weapons at its base. The figure is adorned in a robe with decorative headgear and holds a staff, carrying a shield that contains text. It stands before a backdrop of a dramatic sky with clouds and a coat of arms or emblem above. The columns are similarly elaborate, topped with shield-like decorations and surrounded by assorted objects that suggest themes of war or valor, including arrows, swords, and drums. The etching captures intricate details with fine lines and shading.

artworks.title: Il Solimano, Act I
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 21 × 28.6 cm (8 1/4 × 11 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth B. Benedict in memory of William S. Benedict
artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape from an elevated viewpoint, looking down a wide street with grand architectural buildings on both sides. The horizon is in the middle third of the image, and a large ornate structure with arches is visible in the distance. The style is detailed, resembling etchings with fine lines and cross-hatching used to depict intricate architectural details and figures creating depth and activity. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray and brown, giving an antique feel. Close to us, there are groups of well-dressed people gathered, suggesting a procession or gathering. More figures are dispersed down the street, appearing to be moving towards the distance, contributing to the lively atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: Il Solimano, Act II
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20.3 × 28.4 cm (8 × 11 3/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth B. Benedict in memory of William S. Benedict
artworks.description: The image shows a perspective view looking down an urban street towards a grand, arched structure in the distance. The street is lined with elaborate buildings featuring classical detailing, statues, and people in robes and headpieces walking in a procession. The color palette consists of varying shades of grey and beige, typical of etching techniques, emphasizing detailed line work and crosshatching for shadow and depth.

artworks.title: Il Solimano, Act III
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20.5 × 28.5 cm (8 1/16 × 11 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth B. Benedict in memory of William S. Benedict
artworks.description: The image displays an architectural scene with a perspective view down an urban block. The viewpoint is from street level, looking down a wide avenue bordered by tall, elaborately designed buildings on either side, showcasing classical architectural elements. The horizon is high in the image, featuring diminishing details of buildings and an architectural structure resembling an arched gateway or colonnade in the distance. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic, sepia-toned palette, giving it an antique feel. The artwork shows finely detailed brushstrokes or etching technique, highlighting textures and forms of the architectural elements. Figures in period costumes are depicted in groups, creating a sense of procession or a public event, guiding the viewer's eye towards the distant architectural features that fade into the background.

artworks.title: Il Solimano, Act IV
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 21.6 × 28.6 cm (8 1/2 × 11 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth B. Benedict in memory of William S. Benedict
artworks.description: The image depicts an urban or architectural scene from a central and symmetrical point of view. A street is surrounded by grand buildings with intricate architectural details such as columns, statues in niches, and patterned stonework. People in various flowing garments populate the scene. The drawing style suggests an etching or engraving, using fine lines and crosshatching for texture, depth, and shadow. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of brown or sepia. The sky above shows delicate lines indicating clouds.

artworks.title: Il Solimano, Act V
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth B. Benedict in memory of William S. Benedict
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic and fiery scene in a city during a conflict. The artwork depicts buildings engulfed in flames, with dense clouds of smoke billowing up into the sky. In the foreground and throughout the street, groups of figures are engaged in frantic activity. The architecture of the buildings reflects an ornate and baroque style. The drawing includes intricate details like the dynamic motion of the figures and the stylized depiction of smoke and fire, contributing to the tension and urgency of the scene.

artworks.title: Seated Man Flanked by Two Reclining Figures; Huddle of Figures in Lower Left Corner
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal
artworks.description: The image shows simple, sketch-like lines forming abstract human figure shapes. One figure is sitting with legs bent, while others are lying on a surface. The drawing suggests a bench or platform, with the figures arranged casually. Faint lines in the background hint at more people, completing the abstract gathering scene.

artworks.title: Three Sketches of a Standing Woman
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal
artworks.description: The image shows three full-body sketches of a person in different poses. The left figure appears light and holds a tray with one hand while the other hand rests by the side, with the head tilted downwards. In the center, the outline is more distinct, displaying a person in profile with hands in pockets and long straight hair. The figure on the right is seen from behind with similar long hair and arms positioned with a slight bend at the elbows. All figures wear ankle-length dresses. The background is plain and serves as a surface for the sketches.

artworks.title: Le gueux des campagnes
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Joan Lees in memory of Edward Lees, M.D.
artworks.description: The image shows a person crouching down and holding a long staff. They have a rugged appearance with facial hair, wearing a wide-brimmed straw hat and practical clothing. In the background, there are dense foliage, rustic buildings, and an open landscape under a clear sky.

artworks.title: Title Page for "Agreable diversite de figures"
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Sara L. Lepman
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental page with calligraphic text and decorative elements. The drawing features a central coat of arms flanked by two symmetrical, elaborate plumes or scroll-like decorations that curl outward. Below the coat of arms, there is elegant, calligraphic text arranged in a flowing script. The border and decorations suggest a formality and richness typical of historical documents. The coat of arms is detailed with horizontal stripes and a crown-like design at the top.

artworks.title: Place Dauphine
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Sara L. Lepman
artworks.description: The image depicts a view from an elevated perspective showing two large symmetrical buildings framing a central statue on a raised pedestal. The horizon is high, separating the sky from the urban landscape with various figures. Additional buildings and a cityscape are faintly visible at the horizon. The etching technique is used with detailed textures and shading. The color palette is monochromatic with variations of ink. Many small figures are present near us, engaging in different activities. The area around the statue is bustling with more activity, creating a sense of movement and interaction.

artworks.title: Place Royale
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Sara L. Lepman
artworks.description: The image shows a straight-on view of a grand architectural structure in a plaza, with a statue on a raised plinth as the focal point. The horizon is marked by the elegant line of the building, with the statue in the middle and elevated. The artwork features detailed linework capturing architectural elements, figures, and depth. The color palette is black and white, emphasizing contrast. People are seen walking, gathering, or riding horses in the plaza, with buildings forming a backdrop. The sky is depicted with delicate strokes suggesting clouds and birds.

artworks.title: Forest with Deer Hunt
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Sara L. Lepman
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with riders and a dog. The horizon is high in the frame, with distant hills and trees visible. Two figures on horseback ride from left to right, accompanied by a dog. A deer runs to the right. Detailed trees are on the right, with fine lines defining texture and depth. The monochrome color palette uses shades of ink on paper.

artworks.title: Seated Pilgrims
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Sara L. Lepman
artworks.description: The image shows two figures sitting on a rock under a tree, looking into the distance. The horizon features trees and ruins. The etching technique shows fine lines with cross-hatching for texture and shading in a monochromatic color palette. In the background, there are structures resembling ruins, some figures interacting, and a lone rider on horseback moving towards the horizon.

artworks.title: Gypsies at Rest
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Sara L. Lepman
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a horse in the foreground on the right, two women with a baby and a dog on the left, a group of figures and animals next to a tree further in the distance on the left, and finely detailed horizon. The artwork is done in fine etching, creating a monochromatic sepia color scheme.

artworks.title: Lords and Ladies Conversing
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Sara L. Lepman
artworks.description: The image shows a slightly elevated perspective looking down on a pastoral scene. The horizon is low in the composition with trees and small structures. The sky has sparse linear brushstrokes suggesting clouds. There are figures close to us interacting and further away two figures standing. The color palette is monochromatic with dark ink lines on a pale background.

artworks.title: Horses in a Pasture
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Sara L. Lepman
artworks.description: The image shows a horse lying in the foreground with two other standing horses further back. In the background, there are trees, a high horizon with sparse clouds, and a flock of distant birds. The artwork has intricate etching techniques depicting detailed textures. The color palette is monochromatic with varying degrees of black and white. A small animal, possibly a dog, is curled up near the horse in the center-left area.

artworks.title: Two Goats Lying Down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Sara L. Lepman
artworks.description: The image displays a pastoral scene with a peaceful, rural setting. The horizon is positioned just below the center of the image, extending across the width, marked by a cluster of trees and shrubs. In the distance, a small group of figures and animals can be seen engaged in an activity, possibly near a water body indicated by the horizon line. The brushstrokes or etching strokes are detailed and fine, creating intricate textures in the foliage and animals, notably the resting goat in the foreground. The color palette is monochromatic, using varying shades of brown and beige to create a warm, earthy tone for the countryside setting. The sky features wispy clouds diagonally stretching across, adding depth to the landscape.

artworks.title: Donkey Resting
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Sara L. Lepman
artworks.description: The image shows an animal close to the viewer, looking to the right. A horizon divides the scene in the middle, with a windmill on the left. The animal's fur texture and windmill structure are detailed. Two more animals are in the distance near bushes. The color palette is monochromatic.

artworks.title: Two Pikemen Traveling on Foot
artworks.artist: Claude Goyrand after Stefano Della Bella
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Sara L. Lepman
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body figures walking side by side. They are mid-stride, with the person on the left ahead and looking downward. Both have drawn and weathered facial features, long hair under wide-brimmed hats, heavy cloaks, knee-length trousers, and boots. Each carries a long spear-like object over their shoulder. The figure on the right holds something similar to a fowl. The background is minimalistic with a few sketchy lines indicating a landscape and some trees or bushes in the distance to the right.

artworks.title: Title Page for "Paysages et ruines de Rome"
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Sara L. Lepman
artworks.description: The image is viewed from a slightly elevated angle. A detailed arrangement of architectural and natural elements is seen within a framed, circular composition. A fallen column or architectural structure with detailed text and an emblem on the left side is visible. The text is inscribed within a scroll-like form with an ornate script. In the middle, a large, gracefully bending tree dominates the scene. Its leaves and twisted branches are depicted with fine, intricate brushstrokes. The horizon is relatively low, with a blend of trees and open fields stretching into the distance. Ruins of a stone structure on the far right fade into a lighter form as they reach a distant hillside. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of sepia or dark brown.

artworks.title: Campo Vaccino
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Sara L. Lepman
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting a scene with a slightly elevated point of view. In the foreground, there is a reclining cow, a shepherd, sheep, and a man holding a staff. To the right, a large, ornate fountain structure is visible. In the background, people, horses, and animals gather near the water's edge. The horizon shows classical buildings and a cityscape, with the sky filled with scattered clouds depicted through hatchings. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black, white, and gray with delicate tonal contrasts.

artworks.title: Windblown Horsemen
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Sara L. Lepman
artworks.description: The image shows an etching with an elevated view of two riders on horseback traveling along a winding path. The landscape features rolling hills, sparse vegetation, and no distinct horizon line separating the sky. The etching style is defined by intricate lines detailing the figures, trees, and surrounding scenery. The color palette consists of various shades of black and gray, creating depth and detail. The foreground displays rough terrain with grass tufts and tree shadows, while the background shows softly etched hills and a cloudy sky. The composition is framed in an oval shape, emphasizing the central riders and the path.

artworks.title: Landscape with Roman Ruins
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Sara L. Lepman
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with cattle, sheep, a shepherd, trees, and distant ruins. The drawing features fine etched lines creating textures and shading. The monochromatic color palette highlights the intricate details and contrasts in the landscape.
